Name: First Trumpet
Description:
The sound of duty is riveting, awe-inspiring, and hard to manage. As a reaction to when combat starts, you may tap into that pool of inspiration to coat an area with fanfare and the song of trumpets. Choose up to four creatures in the spells range.

You and the chosen creatures gain a +2 to your Initiative modifier and for the duration of the spell have a +1 to hit on the first attack done during your turn.
At Higher Levels: For each second spell level spent for this spell, add an additional +1 to your Initiative modifier and a +1 to hit. Ex: Casting your spell at 4th level grants a +3 to Initiative and a +2 to hit.
